description: This file defines TypeScript type declarations for the 'Q' promise library, providing type information for promises, deferred objects, and utility functions used for asynchronous programming.

classes.name: Deferred
classes.description: Interface representing a deferred object with promise, resolve, reject, notify, and makeNodeResolver methods.

classes.name: Promise
classes.description: Interface for the promise object, with methods for chaining, handling progress, timeout, and inspecting state.

classes.name: PromiseState
classes.description: Interface describing the state snapshot of a promise, including fulfilled, rejected, or pending.

methods.name: declare function Q<T>(promise: PromiseLike<T> | T): Q.Promise<T>; Q
methods.description: Main function overloads to create or manipulate promises, including promise resolution, rejection, and wrapping functions to return promises.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Creates a deferred object with resolve, reject, promise, notify, and makeNodeResolver methods.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Wraps a value or promise into a fulfilled promise.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Creates a promise that is rejected with the given reason.

methods.name: when
methods.description: Wraps a value or promise, with optional fulfillment, rejection, and progress handlers.

methods.name: fbind
methods.description: Wraps a function in a promise-returning function, binding arguments and converting exceptions to rejections.

methods.name: fcall
methods.description: Invokes a function with arguments, returning a promise of its result, handling sync exceptions and promises.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Calls a method of an object by name, with arguments, returning a promise of the result.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Alias for invoke, calls a method of an object by name.

methods.name: mcall
methods.description: Alias for invoke, calls a method of an object by name.

methods.name: nfbind
methods.description: Converts a Node.js callback-style function into a promise-returning function.

methods.name: denodeify
methods.description: Alias for nfbind.

methods.name: nbind
methods.description: Creates a promise-returning function, binding the context.

methods.name: nfapply
methods.description: Calls a Node.js callback-style function with an array of arguments, returning a promise.

methods.name: nfcall
methods.description: Calls a Node.js callback-style function with variadic arguments, returning a promise.

methods.name: npost
methods.description: Calls a Node.js method with arguments array, returning a promise.

methods.name: ninvoke
methods.description: Calls a Node.js method with variadic arguments, returning a promise.

methods.name: nsend
methods.description: Alias for ninvoke.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills with an array of fulfillment values when all input promises are fulfilled.

methods.name: race
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills with the value of the first promise to settle.

methods.name: allSettled
methods.description: Returns a promise for an array of promise state snapshots once all have settled.

methods.name: allResolved
methods.description: Deprecated alias for allSettled.

methods.name: spread
methods.description: Spreads an array of promises into a variadic fulfillment handler.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Returns a promise that rejects if the input promise does not settle within specified milliseconds.

methods.name: delay
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills after specified milliseconds.

methods.name: isFulfilled
methods.description: Checks if a promise is fulfilled.

methods.name: isRejected
methods.description: Checks if a promise is rejected.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if a promise is pending.

methods.name: Promise
methods.description: A Promise constructor that creates a promise with an explicit resolver function.

methods.name: promised
methods.description: Converts a callback into a promise-returning version that always returns a promise.

methods.name: isPromise
methods.description: Checks if an object is a Q promise.

methods.name: isPromiseAlike
methods.description: Checks if an object looks like a promise (has a then function).

methods.name: nearer
methods.description: Returns the closest fulfillment value or state for a promise.

methods.name: async
methods.description: Converts a generator function into a promise-returning function, possibly yielding promise yields.

methods.name: nextTick
methods.description: Schedules a callback on the next tick of the event loop.

methods.name: onerror
methods.description: Property to intercept uncaught errors in promise chains.

methods.name: longStackSupport
methods.description: Enables long stack traces for debugging asynchronous promise chains.

methods.name: noConflict
methods.description: Resets the global Q variable to its previous value and returns the last version of Q.
